functions.name: Logout

Logs out the player.
This will save and unload the players character, as well as

as well as 'qb-hud:client:OnMoneyChange' events on the client.
A negative amount will be ignored and the function will return false.

parameters.description: the type of money to add (e.g. 'cash', 'bank', etc.)

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the money was successfully added, false otherwise

functions.description:
Removes money from the player's account.
This will update the player's money and trigger the 'QBCore:Client:OnMoneyChange'
as well as 'qb-hud:client:OnMoneyChange' events on the client.
If the account is 'bank' it will also trigger the 'qb-phone:client:RemoveBankMoney' event.
A negative amount will be ignored and the function will return false.

parameters.name: moneytype
parameters.description: the type of money to remove (e.g. 'cash', 'bank', etc.)

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: the amount of money to remove

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason for removing the money (default: 'unknown')

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the money was successfully removed, false otherwise

as well as 'qb-hud:client:OnMoneyChange' events on the client.

parameters.description: the amount of money to set

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: the reason for setting the money (default: 'unknown')

returns.name: success
returns.description: true if the money was successfully set, false otherwise

functions.name: GetMoney
functions.description: Gets the amount of money the player has for the given money type.

parameters.name: moneytype
parameters.description: the type of money to get (e.g. 'cash', 'bank', etc.)

returns.name: amount
returns.description: the amount of money the player has, or nil if the money type is invalid

functions.name: SetCreditCard
functions.description:
Sets the player's credit/debit card number.
This will update the player's character info and trigger the 'QBCore:Player:SetPlayerData' event on the client.

parameters.name: cardNumber
parameters.description: the credit/debit card number to set

functions.name: GetCardSlot
functions.description:
Gets the inventory slot of the player's card with the given card number and type.
This will search the player's inventory for the card and return the slot if found.
If not found, it will return nil.

parameters.name: cardNumber
parameters.description: the credit/debit card number to search for

parameters.name: cardType
parameters.description: the type of card to search for (e.g. 'credit', 'debit', etc.)

returns.name: slot
returns.description: the inventory slot of the card if found, or nil if not found

functions.name: Save
functions.description:
Saves the player to the database.
If the player is offline, this will save the offline player data.
If the player is online, this will save the online player data.

functions.name: Logout
functions.description:
Logs out the player.
This will save and unload the players character, as well as
mark the player as no longer known, meaning trying to receive
the player after a call to this function will probably result
in errors.

functions.name: AddMethod
functions.description:
Adds a new method to the player object.
This will add the given method to the player's Functions table.
This will only affect the current player object and not all player objects.

parameters.name: methodName
parameters.description: the name of the method to add

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: the function to add as the method

functions.name: AddField
functions.description:
Adds a new field to the player object.
This will add the given field to the player object.
This will only affect the current player object and not all player objects.

parameters.name: fieldName
parameters.description: the name of the field to add

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: the data to set the field to
